_meta.source: NICE API + knowledge graph surface forms
_meta.note: SNOMED codes, preferred terms, and surface forms sourced directly from the knowledge graph at 2026-05-12. Three rules are active; 22 are pending_review.

bitmap_scenarios.label: Ex-smoker with 8-week cough aged 55 -- mesothelioma CXR rule fires
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient is 55 (>=40), ex-smoker plus one NG12 respiratory symptom (cough). Logic path: age-gate AND (smoker-branch: smoker-seed matches + AT_LEAST(1) symptom matches).
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 55 yr male. Ex-smoker, stopped 5 years ago. Persistent cough x 8 weeks. No haemoptysis. Sats 96%.

bitmap_scenarios.label: 67yo non-smoker with weight loss and fatigue -- mesothelioma CXR rule fires
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient is 67 (>=40), never smoked, two NG12 respiratory symptoms. Logic path: age-gate AND AT_LEAST(2) branch.
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 67 yr female. Non-smoker. Unexplained weight loss 5 kg over 2 months, fatigue. No fever. Appetite down.

bitmap_scenarios.label: 72yo with rectal mass on DRE -- colorectal referral rule fires
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient is 72 (>=18), finding of rectal mass on digital rectal exam. No smoking history.
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 72 yr female. Presented with change in bowel habit. DRE: rectal mass palpable. Referred 2WW colorectal.

bitmap_scenarios.label: FIT kit declined -- FIT safety netting rule fires
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient declined the FIT kit. Safety netting rule fires regardless of age/demographics.
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 65 yr male. Bowel cancer screening FIT kit declined by patient. Safety netting in place per NG12 1.3.3.

bitmap_scenarios.label: 35yo smoker with cough and fatigue -- age gate blocks mesothelioma rule
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient is 35 (<40 age threshold). Two respiratory symptoms and smoking history but age gate must prevent the mesothelioma rule from firing.
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 35 yr male smoker. Cough and fatigue for 4 weeks. Chest clear on auscultation.

bitmap_scenarios.label: Hypertension and type 2 diabetes -- no NG12 rules fire
bitmap_scenarios.description: Patient codes have no overlap with any NG12 active rule criteria. Confirms the evaluator does not produce false positives.
bitmap_scenarios.encounter_note: 65 yr female. Type 2 diabetes review. HbA1c 58. Hypertension on ramipril. BP 136/82.

extraction_scenarios.label: Visible haematuria -- surface form resolves to Frank hematuria
extraction_scenarios.encounter_note: 68 yr male. Visible haematuria x 3 weeks, no dysuria, no UTI symptoms. MSU sent. Referred 2WW urology.

extraction_scenarios.label: Dysphagia -- surface form resolves to Dysphagia disorder
extraction_scenarios.encounter_note: 55 yr female. Dysphagia for 6 weeks, difficulty swallowing solids more than liquids. No weight loss yet. Referred for UGI endoscopy.

extraction_scenarios.label: Haemoptysis plus smoking history -- both entities extracted
extraction_scenarios.encounter_note: 45 yr female smoker. Haemoptysis x 2 weeks, small volumes, no pleuritic pain. CXR arranged. 2WW lung cancer referral.

extraction_scenarios.label: Unexplained weight loss and rectal bleeding -- both entities extracted
extraction_scenarios.encounter_note: 64 yr male. Unexplained weight loss 6 kg over 3 months. Rectal bleeding x 4 weeks, bright red. FIT test organised.

sbar_scenarios.label: Mesothelioma CXR rule fires -- SBAR recommends urgent chest X-ray within 2 weeks
sbar_scenarios.background_md: No haemoptysis. Oxygen saturation 96%. No prior respiratory investigations.
sbar_scenarios.assessment_md: NG12 rule 1.1.5 fired: ex-smoker aged 40+ with 1 unexplained respiratory symptom.

assessment_rules.name: 1.1.5 Offer an urgent chest X-ray (within 2 weeks) to assess for mesothelioma
assessment_rules.recommendation_verbatim: Offer an urgent chest X-ray (to be done within 2 weeks) to assess for mesothelioma in people aged 40 and over.

guideline_titles: NG12 Suspected cancer: recognition and referral

sbar_scenarios.label: Rectal mass rule fires -- SBAR recommends colorectal cancer referral
sbar_scenarios.situation_md: 72-year-old female with change in bowel habit and palpable rectal mass on DRE.
sbar_scenarios.background_md: No rectal bleeding reported. No prior bowel investigations. DRE confirms rectal mass.
sbar_scenarios.assessment_md: NG12 rule 1.3.5 fired: adult with rectal mass consistent with colorectal cancer.

assessment_rules.name: 1.3.5 Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for colorectal cancer in adults with a rectal mass
assessment_rules.recommendation_verbatim: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for colorectal cancer in adults with a rectal mass.

sbar_scenarios.label: No NG12 rules fire -- SBAR recommendation contains no 2WW actions
sbar_scenarios.situation_md: 65-year-old female presenting for routine hypertension review.
sbar_scenarios.background_md: On ramipril 5mg. BP 136/82. HbA1c 58 (stable). No respiratory or bowel symptoms.
sbar_scenarios.assessment_md: No NG12 suspected cancer rules fired for this encounter.
